Other Effects.label: First activation
Other Effects.value: Mark the location creating [Red Sword] Berserk aura in a radius of 3.

Other Effects.label: Second activation
Other Effects.value: Teleport back to the marked location exploding the previous mark dealing 1000 damage and granting [Wooden Shield] Armored for 5 seconds in a radius of 5.

Other Effects.label: Note
Other Effects.value: Mark is reset upon changing area or after 10 seconds.
